NEX_acquisition.note: 25.5% effective interest in GRPL (which holds NEX) acquired on 6 February 2023. Price $529.8 million from portfolio overview table. Seller not explicitly named in the report for this phase. Value in $'000.

Additional 24.5% effective interest in GRPL acquired on 26 March 2024 ('NEX Acquisition'). The Trust entered into a share purchase agreement with FPL to acquire all ordinary shares in FCL Emerald (1) Pte. Ltd. which holds 49.0% interest in each of NP Trust and FP Coral. Total acquisition outlay approximately $331,011,000 (including transaction costs and completion adjustments). Portfolio overview table (p68) shows purchase price $521.1 million for additional 24.5% interest; the $331,011 is the actual acquisition outlay per Note 7 — the $521.1M figure on p68 reflects the total value of the stake including the intercompany debt repayment. Value in $'000.

Northpoint_City_South_Wing_acquisition.seller: FCL Amber Pte. Ltd. (subsidiary of FPL, 50%) and Bright Bloom Capital Limited (subsidiary of TCC Prosperity Limited, 50%)
Northpoint_City_South_Wing_acquisition.note: Acquisition completed 26 May 2025. FCT acquired 100.0% interest in North Gem Trust (NG Trust) and its trustee-manager Frasers Property North Gem Trustee Pte. Ltd. Agreed property value $1,133.0 million (per p33). Total acquisition outlay ~$393,238,000 (incl. transaction costs). Purchase consideration $380,660,000. Sellers: FCL Amber Pte. Ltd. sold 50% of NG Trust units (wholly-owned subsidiary of FPL); Bright Bloom Capital Limited sold remaining 50% of NG Trust units (wholly-owned subsidiary of TCC Prosperity Limited). Values in $'000.

Yishun10_divestment.note: Yishun 10 Retail Podium (10 strata units at Yishun 10 Cinema Complex) divested on 23 September 2025 for total consideration of $34.5 million. Buyer: Lion (Singapore) Pte. Limited. Negotiated on willing-buyer willing-seller basis after taking into account average of two independent valuations of $34.0 million and $35.0 million as at 31 May 2025. Value in $'000.
